BRC Madoka — Screen Icons
Reference: BRC1H81W Madoka Remote Controller · CEO Villa VRF Concealed Units · IHCC Jeddah
Icons appear on the controller screen to indicate system status, active modes, and maintenance requirements.
Remote Controller Status Icons  Ref: Manual Section 12
ICON NAMECATEGORYDESCRIPTION
LockControlA function or operation mode is locked and cannot be used or selected.
Centralised ControlControlSystem is controlled by central control equipment (optional accessory). Controller access is limited.
Changeover — Central CtrlControlCooling/heating changeover is under centralised control by another indoor unit, or by an optional cool/heat selector on the outdoor unit.
Defrost / Hot StartOperationDefrost or Hot Start mode is currently active.
Schedule / TimerTimerSystem is operating according to a set schedule, or the OFF timer is enabled.
Time Not SetTimerThe controller's internal time has not been set.
Self-Cleaning FilterMaintenanceSelf-cleaning filter operation is currently active.
Quick StartOperationQuick Start mode is active. (Sky Air units only)
Test OperationCommissioningTest Operation mode is active. (Sky Air units only)
InspectionMaintenanceThe indoor or outdoor unit is currently being inspected.
Periodic InspectionMaintenanceThe indoor or outdoor unit is undergoing periodic inspection.
Backup UnitSystemAn indoor unit in the system is designated as a backup indoor unit.
Individual Airflow DirectionComfortIndividual airflow direction setting is enabled for this unit.
InformationStatusThe system has a message. Navigate to the information screen to read it.
WarningAlertAn error has occurred, or an indoor unit component requires maintenance attention.
Power Consumption LimitEnergySystem power consumption is being limited. Unit is running with restricted capacity.
End of Power LimitEnergyPower consumption limit has ended. System is no longer restricted and running at full capacity.
Rotation ModeSystemRotation mode is active.
SetbackOperationThe indoor unit is operating under setback temperature conditions.
VentilationOperationA heat reclaim ventilation unit is connected to the system.
System Status Icons  Ref: Section 4.2
ICON NAMEDESCRIPTION
System Operation ONSystem is currently in operation (running).
System Operation OFFSystem is NOT in operation (stopped).
BluetoothController is communicating with a mobile device via the Madoka Assistant app.
Operation Mode Icons  Ref: Section 5.2
MODEDESCRIPTION
CoolingCooling is activated as required by the setpoint or Setback operation.
HeatingHeating is activated as required by the setpoint or Setback operation.
Fan OnlyAir circulates without heating or cooling.
DryAir humidity is lowered with minimal temperature decrease. Temperature and fan speed are auto-controlled and cannot be manually adjusted. Does not operate if room temp is too low.
VentilationSpace is ventilated but is not cooled or heated.
Air CleanThe optional air cleaning unit operates.
Ventilation + Air CleanCombined ventilation and air clean operation active simultaneously.
Auto (Heating)Auto mode — indoor unit automatically switches between heating and cooling as required by the setpoint. (Heating icon shown)
Auto (Cooling)Auto mode — indoor unit automatically switches between heating and cooling as required by the setpoint. (Cooling icon shown)
Maintenance Warning Icons  Ref: Section 6.1
WARNINGDESCRIPTION
Clean Indoor Unit FilterWarning screen shown when air filter requires cleaning. Controller also displays Warning icon (⚠) on home screen.
Replace Indoor Unit FilterWarning screen shown when air filter must be fully replaced. Appears on home screen and when entering main menu.
Empty Indoor Unit DustboxWarning screen shown when the indoor unit dustbox needs to be emptied. Consult dealer if unsure of procedure.
⚠ Maintenance Trigger: When maintenance is due, the Warning (⚠) icon appears on the home screen AND a warning screen shows when entering the main menu.

Construction Phase Note: During active construction at CEO Villa, increase filter inspection frequency due to elevated dust levels in the space.
